notes: IB classes. Each class has a Grading button: points and percent, IB MYP or IB DP. The welcome and Settings offer IB MYP criteria (0 to 8) and IB DP 1 to 7 as two separate choices.

An MYP class is marked against the criteria a task assesses, each 0 to 8, with no percent. Its gradebook shows every level a student earned, you choose the level that fits best for each criterion, and the total becomes a final grade of 1 to 7. Levels are never averaged.
Criterion names and the grade boundaries are yours to change. A DP class shows the 1 to 7 its percent earns on boundaries you type in.
